title: Report a patient's medical condition to Transport for NSW
summary: Medical practitioners can report a patient's impaired ability to drive safely to Transport for NSW using the Medical Condition Notification Form.
intro:
If you're a medical practitioner and assess that a patient's ability to drive safely is impaired, you can submit a Medical Condition Notification Form online.

If you are making a direct report to Transport for NSW, you may wish to inform your patient.

When assessing fitness to drive, refer to Assessing Fitness to Drive for the medical standards.

### Information for older drivers

For information on what to do to keep driving or riding after you turn 70 see the guide for Older drivers, riders and road users.
who_can_apply: You must be a medical practitioner.
You must assess that a patient's ability to drive safely is impaired.
what_you_need: The patient's full name, date of birth, and address.
The patient's driver licence number (if known).
Evidence of how the patient meets or does not meet the criteria detailed in Assessing Fitness to Drive.
Recommendations for further assessment or licence conditions/restrictions (if applicable).
Access to the HealthLink Portal (your practice’s SmartForms portal).

how_to_steps.text: Log in to the HealthLink portal.If you do not have an account you can register for access to the HealthLink Portal.Note: Approval for access may take up to 5 business days.
Select 'Transport for NSW' and follow the prompts to submit the 'Medical Condition Notification' form.
Download and complete the Medical Condition Notification Form – PDF.
Submit the form, along with any additional documents, to Transport for NSW using the email or postal address on the form.

more_info.text: Transport for NSW will also accept a letter from you, provided it includes sufficient information to make a decision on the patient's fitness to drive.

faqs.q: Who should report a patient's medical condition?
faqs.a: A medical practitioner should report a patient's medical condition if they assess that the patient's ability to drive safely is impaired.

faqs.q: Where can I find medical standards for assessing fitness to drive?
faqs.a: Refer to Assessing Fitness to Drive for the medical standards.

faqs.q: What is the process for submitting the report?
faqs.a: You can submit the report online via the HealthLink portal, or download and submit the Medical Condition Notification Form – PDF using email or postal address.
